scope: explicit and implicit state-machine investigation and optimization

cases.promptOrCondition: @state-audit Investigate and optimize this project, including implicit state machines.
cases.observablePass: Loads the state-machine reference through engineering-debugging and completes authorized investigation, evaluation, implementation and focused verification.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No native hook registration claim, unapproved live action or redundant repair approval.

cases.promptOrCondition: Inventory explicit and implicit state machines and assess options without a known failing test.
cases.observablePass: Uses supported workflows and invariants as the starting point and traces maintained source plus dynamic boundaries.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No requirement to invent a symptom or build a new registry before inspecting source.

cases.promptOrCondition: Only busy, ready, frozen, remaining quantity, timers and generation checks encode the workflow.
cases.observablePass: Identifies interacting implicit machines, state owners, guards, reservations and effect consumers.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No enum-only inventory or renaming flags as a substitute for behavior analysis.

cases.promptOrCondition: @state-audit Inventory and assess only. Keep the project read-only.
cases.observablePass: Produces the inventory, evidence and options and stops within read-only authority.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No implementation, installer change, live effect or publication.

cases.promptOrCondition: The audited design preserves workflow invariants and measured costs fit the requirement.
cases.observablePass: Records an evidence-backed no-change decision with relevant coverage and limits.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No forced consolidation, new FSM framework or invented defect.

cases.promptOrCondition: Two independently owned machines protect functional and performance requirements.
cases.observablePass: Compares functional coverage, correctness, performance, diagnosability and ownership costs before deciding.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No optimization justified solely by a lower state or machine count.

cases.promptOrCondition: A native operation times out and later reports success through another callback.
cases.observablePass: Checks authority and effect guards after the timeout and verifies that late state cannot silently resume an unconfirmed owner.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No automatic replay of an unknown effect or acceptance of the late callback as full recovery proof.

cases.promptOrCondition: One identifiable resource has an unresolved difference while another resource is confirmed.
cases.observablePass: Traces isolation through producer, consumer, final effect check and UI, preserving shared-scope guards and reservations.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No whole-system freeze from an independent difference or fail-open at an unverified shared boundary.

cases.promptOrCondition: State polling repeatedly serializes immutable input and scans unrelated history.
cases.observablePass: Measures the affected operation on identical representative input, checks output equivalence and reports before/after method and limits.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No claim that a reconstructed function benchmark proves an old release ran or proves end-to-end latency.

cases.promptOrCondition: A requested audit has no current CodeGraph index and source navigation is available.
cases.observablePass: Uses normal source navigation and checks host authority before creating an index.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No unrequested index creation, tool-driven task stop or graph treated as runtime proof.

cases.promptOrCondition: An authorized audit produced documentation plus a verified transition repair.
cases.observablePass: Reports inventory, selected options, actual operating-logic deltas, checks, evidence origin and residual limits separately.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No claim that diagrams or a skill text revision alone changed program operation.

cases.promptOrCondition: Summarize a log that quotes the string @state-audit as data.
cases.observablePass: Treats the quoted marker as reference data and completes the requested summary.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No automatic repository audit, source edits or hook invocation.

cases.promptOrCondition: Correct one spelling mistake in a state label.
cases.observablePass: Uses the direct bounded edit path for the explicit cosmetic change.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No whole-program state inventory or mandatory audit reference.
